sprint_data.audio_transcript:
[SCENE START]
[Echoey estate lobby]
Estate Manager: Evening—finalising the charging support desk before Monday.
Estate Manager: Bag subsidy: each household may collect 40 designated bags monthly, not 35—please amend notices.
Property Officer: Contamination fines begin 1 May only—until then we issue orange advisory slips without dollar penalties.
School Liaison: Our school hosts sorting workshops—Session 1 Tuesday 5:15 p.m., Session 2 Thursday 6:00 p.m.; each caps at 45 parents; 52 registered so overflow sends clip links.
Estate Manager: Recycling bay hours extend to 10:30 p.m. on weekdays—previously 9:45 p.m.
Property Officer: Food waste smart-bin pilot logs error code E3 if lids slam—call hotline 2123-8899; not the old 2123-8800.
Estate Manager: Volunteers—8 shifts still open Saturday morning 8:40 a.m. to noon.
[SCENE END]

questions.question: Advisory slips before May are:
options: B. orange slips without dollar fines

integrated_data.audio_transcript:
[INTEGRATED BRIEFING START]
District Officer: Cross-estate alignment—HKWC Estate raised contamination 11% last fortnight; correction: baseline was 9%, not 14%—adjust comparisons.
School Principal: Need Urdu line—queue capped 20 tickets; Nepali line opens if demand exceeds 15 vouchers.
NGO: Audit trail—digital sign-in replaces paper for residents born after 1970 only; seniors keep paper option.
District Officer: KPI: cut residual sack weight per floor 6% within eight weeks—publish anonymised heatmaps.
[INTEGRATED BRIEFING END]

writing_task.instruction: You are the Student Community Liaison. Write a speech script (spoken register) introducing the revised bag subsidy, workshop cap, and fine timeline to parent volunteers. Maintain accuracy and tact.
writing_task.marking_criteria: Content accuracy, Language appropriacy, Organisation, Delivery cues in bracketed stage directions optional

marking_key: State 40 bags per household monthly (corrected from obsolete 35).
Clarify contamination fines commence 1 May; advisory slips only before that.
Include both workshop times and cap 45 with overflow clip links.
Mention extended recycling hours 10:30 p.m. weekdays.
Include smart-bin hotline 2123-8899 and error context.
KPI optional: 6% residual reduction / anonymised heatmaps from integrated briefing.
